#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Launch one fresh research worker or independent judge with retained evidence."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import shutil
import tempfile
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import tomllib
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from study_seed import audit_seed, research_prompt
from research_conditions import CONDITION_CHOICES, RESEARCH_SKILLS, canonical_condition

STUDY_SKILLS = ("assess-alignment-with-stamped-principles",) + RESEARCH_SKILLS
JUDGE_SKILLS = {"assess-alignment-with-stamped-principles", "stamped-conventions"}


def selected_skills(role, condition):
    if role == "judge":
        return JUDGE_SKILLS
    return set(RESEARCH_SKILLS) if canonical_condition(condition) == "stamped-explicit" else set()


def check_assessment(source, expected_pin):
    """Check external coordinator sources, never a worker-supplied assessor."""
    pin = json.loads(expected_pin.read_text())
    head = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(source), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
    dirty = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(source), "status", "--porcelain"])
    if head != pin["source_commit"] or dirty:
        raise SystemExit("Judge assessment source is changed or at the wrong revision")
    modules = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(source), "submodule", "status", "--recursive"])
    if any(line[:1] != b" " for line in modules.splitlines()):
        raise SystemExit("Judge assessment dependencies differ from their recorded revisions")
    if any(not (source / "skills" / name / "SKILL.md").is_file() for name in JUDGE_SKILLS):
        raise SystemExit("Frozen assessment skill entrypoint is missing")
    return pin


def launch_profile(prepared_profile, assessment_source=None):
    """Isolate each session's installs/history; reuse only host auth and trust.

    Keep host authentication links outside retained evidence. The copied public
    config carries existing exact-path hook approvals; no new trust is granted.
    """
    role = "judge" if assessment_source else "research"
    profile = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="stamped-" + role + "-", dir=prepared_profile.parent))
    shutil.copyfile(prepared_profile / "config.toml", profile / "config.toml")
    (profile / "config.toml").chmod(0o600)
    auth = prepared_profile / "auth.json"
    if auth.exists():
        (profile / "auth.json").symlink_to(auth.resolve())
    cache = prepared_profile / "models_cache.json"
    if cache.is_file():
        shutil.copy2(cache, profile / "models_cache.json")
    skills = profile / "skills"
    skills.mkdir()
    if assessment_source:
        for name in sorted(JUDGE_SKILLS):
            (skills / name).symlink_to(assessment_source.resolve() / "skills" / name)
    return profile


def judge_profile(prepared_profile, assessment_source):
    return launch_profile(prepared_profile, assessment_source)


def skill_catalog(preview):
    """Read the native developer catalog, expanding its per-block path aliases."""
    text = preview.decode()
    try:
        messages = json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        blocks = [text]  # Plain-text previews from older runtimes/fixtures.
    else:
        if not isinstance(messages, list) or not all(isinstance(message, dict) for message in messages):
            raise SystemExit("Unsupported native prompt preview format")
        blocks = []
        for message in messages:
            if message.get("role") == "developer":
                for item in message.get("content", []):
                    blocks += re.findall(r"<skills_instructions>(.*?)</skills_instructions>",
                                         item.get("text", ""), re.DOTALL)
        if not blocks:
            raise SystemExit("Native preview lacks an inspectable skill catalog")
    catalog = []
    for block in blocks:
        roots = dict(re.findall(r"^- `([^`]+)` = `([^`]+)`\s*$", block, re.MULTILINE))
        entries = re.findall(r"^- ([\w:-]+): .+ \(file: (.+)\)\s*$", block, re.MULTILINE)
        declared = [line for line in block.split("### Available skills")[-1].splitlines()
                    if line.startswith("- ") and not line.startswith("- `")]
        if len(entries) != len(declared):
            raise SystemExit("Unparsed advertised skill entry in native preview")
        for name, raw in entries:
            path = Path(raw)
            if not path.is_absolute() and path.parts and path.parts[0] in roots:
                path = Path(roots[path.parts[0]]).joinpath(*path.parts[1:])
            if not path.is_absolute():
                raise SystemExit("Unresolved advertised skill path: " + raw)
            item = {"name": name, "path": str(path.resolve())}
            if path.is_file():
                item["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            catalog.append(item)
    return catalog


def host_skill_paths(prepared_profile):
    """Refresh exclusions; an old public profile may predate a host install."""
    roots = (Path.home() / ".agents/skills", Path.home() / ".codex/skills",
             Path("/etc/codex/skills"), prepared_profile / "skills")
    return {path for root in roots for path in root.glob("*/SKILL.md")}


def skill_observations(checkout, profile):
    """Inventory installed entrypoints; installation does not establish use."""
    files = []
    for root in (checkout / ".agents/skills", checkout / ".codex/skills", profile / "skills"):
        # Include normal nested installs plus top-level symlinked skill folders.
        for path in sorted(set(root.rglob("SKILL.md")) | set(root.glob("*/SKILL.md"))):
            if path.is_file():
                files.append({"path": str(path), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    return {
        "status": "not-reviewed",
        "evidence": {"events": "events.jsonl", "initial_catalog": "prompt-preflight.json"},
        "installed_entrypoints": files,
        "queries": None, "candidates": None, "selection_rationale": None,
        "source_revisions": None, "installation_cost_and_outcome": None,
        "loaded_instructions": None, "application_evidence": None,
    }


def wait_for_worker(process, output, hard_limit, review_after):
    """A review notification does not terminate useful work; limits are opt-in."""
    started = time.monotonic()
    deadline = started + hard_limit if hard_limit else None
    review = started + review_after if review_after else None
    while True:
        now = time.monotonic()
        pending = [t for t in (deadline, review) if t is not None]
        timeout = max(0, min(pending) - now) if pending else None
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=timeout)
            return False
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            now = time.monotonic()
            if review is not None and now >= review:
                receipt = {"event": "review_due", "elapsed_seconds": now - started,
                           "pid": process.pid, "terminated": False}
                (output / "review.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
                print(json.dumps(receipt), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
                review = None
            if deadline is not None and now >= deadline:
                return True


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--checkout", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--prompt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--cli", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=int, default=0,
                        help="Explicit hard limit; 0 (default) waits for completion")
    parser.add_argument("--review-seconds", type=int, default=5400,
                        help="Emit a progress-review receipt without stopping; 0 disables")
    parser.add_argument("--model", default="gpt-6-luna")
    parser.add_argument("--effort", default="high")
    parser.add_argument("--role", choices=["research", "judge"], default="research")
    parser.add_argument("--assessment-pin", type=Path,
                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "assessment-version.json")
    parser.add_argument("--assessment-source", type=Path,
                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "assessment")
    parser.add_argument("--condition", choices=CONDITION_CHOICES, default="baseline")
    parser.add_argument("--preflight-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--capture-execution", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.seconds < 0 or args.review_seconds < 0:
        parser.error("Time settings must be nonnegative")
    pin = check_assessment(args.assessment_source.resolve(), args.assessment_pin) if args.role == "judge" else None
    if args.role == "research":
        seed = audit_seed(args.checkout.resolve())
        if canonical_condition(seed["condition"]) != canonical_condition(args.condition):
            raise SystemExit("Requested condition differs from the worker seed")
        args.condition = seed["condition"]
        if args.prompt.read_bytes() != research_prompt(args.checkout, args.capture_execution):
            raise SystemExit("Research prompt differs from committed input and common execution guidance")
    output = args.output.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    prompt = args.prompt.read_bytes()
    (output / "prompt.txt").write_bytes(prompt)
    if args.role == "research":
        assigned = dict(seed.get("assignment", {"condition": seed["condition"],
                        "additional_prompt": "", "legacy_input_version": seed["version"]}))
        assigned.update(prompt_sha256=hashlib.sha256(prompt).hexdigest(),
                        coordinator_commit=seed["coordinator_commit"],
                        supplied_skills_commit=seed.get("skills_commit"),
                        capture_execution=args.capture_execution)
        (output / "condition-assignment.json").write_text(json.dumps(assigned, indent=2) + "\n")
    prepared_profile = Path(os.environ.get("CODEX_HOME", str(Path.home() / ".codex")))
    profile = launch_profile(prepared_profile, args.assessment_source if args.role == "judge" else None)
    config = tomllib.loads((profile / "config.toml").read_text())
    overrides = {item["path"]: item["enabled"] for item in config.get("skills", {}).get("config", [])}
    overrides.update({str(path): False for path in host_skill_paths(prepared_profile)})
    study_skills = ([profile / "skills" / name / "SKILL.md"
                     for name in sorted(JUDGE_SKILLS)] if args.role == "judge" else
                    [args.checkout.resolve() / ".agents/skills" / name / "SKILL.md"
                     for name in STUDY_SKILLS])
    selected = selected_skills(args.role, args.condition)
    if any(not path.is_file() for path in study_skills if path.parent.name in selected):
        raise SystemExit("Selected role requires installed skill entrypoints")
    # Do not disable nonexistent local skill paths in discovery/baseline arms:
    # a worker may spontaneously discover and install them after launch.
    overrides.update({str(path): path.parent.name in selected for path in study_skills if path.is_file()})

    refrows = run(["git", "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname)", "refs/entire/checkpoints"], root).decode().splitlines()
    matches = [r.split() for r in refrows if r.split()[0].endswith("/" + metadata["checkpoint_id"])]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise SystemExit("Checkpoint ref identity ambiguous")
    ref, oid = matches[0]
    result = {"verified_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "checkout": str(root),
              "commit": commit, "code_ref": args.code_ref, "checkpoint_id": metadata["checkpoint_id"],
              "code_ref_oid": code_ref_oid, "child_task_id": args.task,
              "event_checkout": str(event_root), "event_commit": child_commit,
              "checkpoint_ref": ref, "checkpoint_oid": oid, "branch": metadata.get("branch"),
              "session_id": args.session, "all_checkpoint_session_ids": [s["session_id"] for s in metadata["sessions"]],
              "native_capture_verified": True, "identities": identities, "file_events": events,
              "transcript_sha256": hashlib.sha256(transcript).hexdigest(), "transcript_bytes": len(transcript),
              "private_guidance_marker_hits": [s for s in ("memory/transport.json", "sensitive transport configuration",
                 "private overlay", "Hub token file") if s.encode() in transcript],
              "raw_transcript_saved": False, "uploaded_refs_verified": False, "hosted_verified": False}
    if args.require_uploaded:
        remote = run(["git", "remote", "get-url", "--push", "origin"], root).decode().strip()
        if not remote.startswith("git@github.com:"):
            raise SystemExit("Expected configured SSH push remote")
        refs = {args.code_ref: code_ref_oid, ref: oid}
        actual = dict(reversed(row.split()) for row in run(["git", "ls-remote", "--refs", remote, *refs], root).decode().splitlines())
        if actual != refs:
            raise SystemExit("Uploaded refs differ from expected exact OIDs")
        result["uploaded_refs_verified"] = True
    if args.hosted_repo:
        hosted = json.loads(run(["entire", "checkpoint", "explain", metadata["checkpoint_id"],
                                "--repo", args.hosted_repo, "--json"], root))
        ids = [s["session_id"] for s in hosted.get("sessions", [])]
        result["hosted_verified"] = hosted.get("checkpoint_id") == metadata["checkpoint_id"] and args.session in ids
        result["hosted_session_ids"] = ids
        if args.task:
            result["hosted_child_task_verified"] = any(t.get("agent_id") == args.task and t.get("transcript_stored")
                for t in hosted.get("tasks", []))
            result["hosted_verified"] = result["hosted_verified"] and result["hosted_child_task_verified"]
        if not result["hosted_verified"]:
            raise SystemExit("Hosted metadata did not match")
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Launch one fresh research worker or independent judge with retained evidence."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import shutil
import tempfile
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import tomllib
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from study_seed import audit_seed, research_prompt
from research_conditions import CONDITION_CHOICES, RESEARCH_SKILLS, canonical_condition

STUDY_SKILLS = ("assess-alignment-with-stamped-principles",) + RESEARCH_SKILLS
JUDGE_SKILLS = {"assess-alignment-with-stamped-principles", "stamped-conventions"}


def selected_skills(role, condition):
    if role == "judge":
        return JUDGE_SKILLS
    return set(RESEARCH_SKILLS) if canonical_condition(condition) == "stamped-explicit" else set()


def check_assessment(source, expected_pin):
    """Check external coordinator sources, never a worker-supplied assessor."""
    pin = json.loads(expected_pin.read_text())
    head = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(source), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
    dirty = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(source), "status", "--porcelain"])
    if head != pin["source_commit"] or dirty:
        raise SystemExit("Judge assessment source is changed or at the wrong revision")
    modules = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(source), "submodule", "status", "--recursive"])
    if any(line[:1] != b" " for line in modules.splitlines()):
        raise SystemExit("Judge assessment dependencies differ from their recorded revisions")
    if any(not (source / "skills" / name / "SKILL.md").is_file() for name in JUDGE_SKILLS):
        raise SystemExit("Frozen assessment skill entrypoint is missing")
    return pin


def launch_profile(prepared_profile, assessment_source=None):
    """Isolate each session's installs/history; reuse only host auth and trust.

    Keep host authentication links outside retained evidence. The copied public
    config carries existing exact-path hook approvals; no new trust is granted.
    """
    role = "judge" if assessment_source else "research"
    profile = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="stamped-" + role + "-", dir=prepared_profile.parent))
    shutil.copyfile(prepared_profile / "config.toml", profile / "config.toml")
    (profile / "config.toml").chmod(0o600)
    auth = prepared_profile / "auth.json"
    if auth.exists():
        (profile / "auth.json").symlink_to(auth.resolve())
    cache = prepared_profile / "models_cache.json"
    if cache.is_file():
        shutil.copy2(cache, profile / "models_cache.json")
    skills = profile / "skills"
    skills.mkdir()
    if assessment_source:
        for name in sorted(JUDGE_SKILLS):
            (skills / name).symlink_to(assessment_source.resolve() / "skills" / name)
    return profile


def judge_profile(prepared_profile, assessment_source):
    return launch_profile(prepared_profile, assessment_source)


def skill_catalog(preview):
    """Read the native developer catalog, expanding its per-block path aliases."""
    text = preview.decode()
    try:
        messages = json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        blocks = [text]  # Plain-text previews from older runtimes/fixtures.
    else:
        if not isinstance(messages, list) or not all(isinstance(message, dict) for message in messages):
            raise SystemExit("Unsupported native prompt preview format")
        blocks = []
        for message in messages:
            if message.get("role") == "developer":
                for item in message.get("content", []):
                    blocks += re.findall(r"<skills_instructions>(.*?)</skills_instructions>",
                                         item.get("text", ""), re.DOTALL)
        if not blocks:
            raise SystemExit("Native preview lacks an inspectable skill catalog")
    catalog = []
    for block in blocks:
        roots = dict(re.findall(r"^- `([^`]+)` = `([^`]+)`\s*$", block, re.MULTILINE))
        entries = re.findall(r"^- ([\w:-]+): .+ \(file: (.+)\)\s*$", block, re.MULTILINE)
        declared = [line for line in block.split("### Available skills")[-1].splitlines()
                    if line.startswith("- ") and not line.startswith("- `")]
        if len(entries) != len(declared):
            raise SystemExit("Unparsed advertised skill entry in native preview")
        for name, raw in entries:
            path = Path(raw)
            if not path.is_absolute() and path.parts and path.parts[0] in roots:
                path = Path(roots[path.parts[0]]).joinpath(*path.parts[1:])
            if not path.is_absolute():
                raise SystemExit("Unresolved advertised skill path: " + raw)
            item = {"name": name, "path": str(path.resolve())}
            if path.is_file():
                item["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            catalog.append(item)
    return catalog


def host_skill_paths(prepared_profile):
    """Refresh exclusions; an old public profile may predate a host install."""
    roots = (Path.home() / ".agents/skills", Path.home() / ".codex/skills",
             Path("/etc/codex/skills"), prepared_profile / "skills")
    return {path for root in roots for path in root.glob("*/SKILL.md")}


def skill_observations(checkout, profile):
    """Inventory installed entrypoints; installation does not establish use."""
    files = []
    for root in (checkout / ".agents/skills", checkout / ".codex/skills", profile / "skills"):
        # Include normal nested installs plus top-level symlinked skill folders.
        for path in sorted(set(root.rglob("SKILL.md")) | set(root.glob("*/SKILL.md"))):
            if path.is_file():
                files.append({"path": str(path), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    return {
        "status": "not-reviewed",
        "evidence": {"events": "events.jsonl", "initial_catalog": "prompt-preflight.json"},
        "installed_entrypoints": files,
        "queries": None, "candidates": None, "selection_rationale": None,
        "source_revisions": None, "installation_cost_and_outcome": None,
        "loaded_instructions": None, "application_evidence": None,
    }


def wait_for_worker(process, output, hard_limit, review_after):
    """A review notification does not terminate useful work; limits are opt-in."""
    started = time.monotonic()
    deadline = started + hard_limit if hard_limit else None
    review = started + review_after if review_after else None
    while True:
        now = time.monotonic()
        pending = [t for t in (deadline, review) if t is not None]
        timeout = max(0, min(pending) - now) if pending else None
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=timeout)
            return False
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            now = time.monotonic()
            if review is not None and now >= review:
                receipt = {"event": "review_due", "elapsed_seconds": now - started,
                           "pid": process.pid, "terminated": False}
                (output / "review.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
                print(json.dumps(receipt), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
                review = None
            if deadline is not None and now >= deadline:
                return True


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--checkout", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--prompt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--cli", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=int, default=0,
                        help="Explicit hard limit; 0 (default) waits for completion")
    parser.add_argument("--review-seconds", type=int, default=5400,
                        help="Emit a progress-review receipt without stopping; 0 disables")
    parser.add_argument("--model", default="gpt-6-luna")
    parser.add_argument("--effort", default="high")
    parser.add_argument("--role", choices=["research", "judge"], default="research")
    parser.add_argument("--assessment-pin", type=Path,
                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "assessment-version.json")
    parser.add_argument("--assessment-source", type=Path,
                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "assessment")
    parser.add_argument("--condition", choices=CONDITION_CHOICES, default="baseline")
    parser.add_argument("--preflight-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--capture-execution", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.seconds < 0 or args.review_seconds < 0:
        parser.error("Time settings must be nonnegative")
    pin = check_assessment(args.assessment_source.resolve(), args.assessment_pin) if args.role == "judge" else None
    if args.role == "research":
        seed = audit_seed(args.checkout.resolve())
        if canonical_condition(seed["condition"]) != canonical_condition(args.condition):
            raise SystemExit("Requested condition differs from the worker seed")
        args.condition = seed["condition"]
        if args.prompt.read_bytes() != research_prompt(args.checkout, args.capture_execution):
            raise SystemExit("Research prompt differs from committed input and common execution guidance")
    output = args.output.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    prompt = args.prompt.read_bytes()
    (output / "prompt.txt").write_bytes(prompt)
    if args.role == "research":
        assigned = dict(seed.get("assignment", {"condition": seed["condition"],
                        "additional_prompt": "", "legacy_input_version": seed["version"]}))
        assigned.update(prompt_sha256=hashlib.sha256(prompt).hexdigest(),
                        coordinator_commit=seed["coordinator_commit"],
                        supplied_skills_commit=seed.get("skills_commit"),
                        capture_execution=args.capture_execution)
        (output / "condition-assignment.json").write_text(json.dumps(assigned, indent=2) + "\n")
    prepared_profile = Path(os.environ.get("CODEX_HOME", str(Path.home() / ".codex")))
    profile = launch_profile(prepared_profile, args.assessment_source if args.role == "judge" else None)
    config = tomllib.loads((profile / "config.toml").read_text())
    overrides = {item["path"]: item["enabled"] for item in config.get("skills", {}).get("config", [])}
    overrides.update({str(path): False for path in host_skill_paths(prepared_profile)})
    study_skills = ([profile / "skills" / name / "SKILL.md"
                     for name in sorted(JUDGE_SKILLS)] if args.role == "judge" else
                    [args.checkout.resolve() / ".agents/skills" / name / "SKILL.md"
                     for name in STUDY_SKILLS])
    selected = selected_skills(args.role, args.condition)
    if any(not path.is_file() for path in study_skills if path.parent.name in selected):
        raise SystemExit("Selected role requires installed skill entrypoints")
    # Do not disable nonexistent local skill paths in discovery/baseline arms:
    # a worker may spontaneously discover and install them after launch.
    overrides.update({str(path): path.parent.name in selected for path in study_skills if path.is_file()})

"""Create, prepare and launch a fresh native session using existing host tools.

Never pushes. All generated evidence belongs outside the new worker checkout.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json

def run(argv, cwd, capture=False):
    result = subprocess.run([str(x) for x in argv], cwd=cwd, check=True,
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE if capture else None, text=True)
    return result.stdout.strip() if capture else None



def retrieve_inputs(git_command, checkout, inventory, remote):
    """Retrieve selected keys without importing source annex location history."""
    for item in inventory:
        if "annex_key" not in item or (checkout / item["path"]).exists():
            continue
        # get --from silently skips keys with no location record. transferkey
        # contacts the configured mirror directly and retains the original key.
        result = subprocess.run(git_command + ["annex", "transferkey", item["annex_key"],
                                "--from", remote], cwd=checkout,
                                capture_output=True, text=True)
        if result.returncode:
            if not item.get("urls"):
                sys.stderr.write(result.stdout + result.stderr)
                result.check_returncode()
            run(git_command + ["annex", "get", "--", item["path"]], checkout)
        else:
            # transferkey records the local copy, not the remote location.
            # Record the mirror that just supplied these bytes for later clones.
            uuid = run(git_command + ["config", "--get", "remote." + remote + ".annex-uuid"],
                       checkout, True)
            run(git_command + ["annex", "setpresentkey", item["annex_key"], uuid, "1"], checkout)
        if not (checkout / item["path"]).is_file():
            raise SystemExit("Input content was not retrieved: " + item["path"])


def render_judge_prompt(template, study, target_commit, evidence, reference=None):
    """Retain the coordinator's scientific brief independently of the target."""
    content = study.read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
    (evidence / "study.md").write_bytes(content)
    (evidence / "study.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "source": str(study.resolve()), "sha256": digest,
    }, indent=2) + "\n")
    prompt = template.read_text().replace("$TARGET_COMMIT", target_commit)
    prompt += ("\nScientific task supplied by the coordinator (SHA-256 " + digest + ").\n"
               "Use this retained brief, not a worker-edited replacement.\n"
               "Relative source links refer to input/ in the assessed object.\n\n"
               + content.decode())
    if reference:
        material = reference.read_bytes()
        (evidence / "reference.md").write_bytes(material)
        (evidence / "reference.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "source": str(reference.resolve()),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(material).hexdigest(),
        }, indent=2) + "\n")
        prompt += ("\nOptional coordinator evaluation guidance, separate from the scientific task.\n"
                   "Alternative scientifically defensible methods are allowed.\n"
                   "Relative links resolve from " + str(reference.resolve().parent) + ".\n\n"
                   + material.decode())
    destination = evidence / "judge-prompt.md"
    destination.write_text(prompt)
    return destination

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run explicitly requested resource checks and retain a receipt for every outcome."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import time


def timestamp():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def write_json(path, value):
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def digest(path):
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def validate(requirements, host):
    """Reject ambiguous plans before executing any command."""
    for name, value, keys in (
        ("requirements", requirements, {"schema_version", "requirements"}),
        ("host config", host, {"schema_version", "checks"}),
    ):
        if (not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != keys
                or type(value["schema_version"]) is not int or value["schema_version"] != 1):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must have schema_version 1 and {sorted(keys - {'schema_version'})}")
    rows = requirements["requirements"]
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
        raise ValueError("requirements must be a nonempty list")
    if not isinstance(host["checks"], dict):
        raise ValueError("host checks must be an object keyed by requirement ID")
    seen = set()
    for row in rows:
        if not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != {"id", "description", "source"}:
            raise ValueError("Each requirement needs exactly id, description and source")
        if not all(isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() for value in row.values()):
            raise ValueError("Requirement fields must be nonempty strings")
        identifier = row["id"]
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,79}", identifier) or identifier in seen:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid or duplicate requirement ID: {identifier}")
        seen.add(identifier)
        if identifier not in host["checks"]:
            continue
        check = host["checks"][identifier]
        if (not isinstance(check, dict) or not {"argv", "cwd"} <= set(check)
                or set(check) - {"argv", "cwd", "timeout_seconds", "artifacts"}):
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: check needs argv and cwd; optional timeout_seconds and artifacts")
        argv = check["argv"]
        if (not isinstance(argv, list) or not argv
                or not all(isinstance(arg, str) and "\0" not in arg for arg in argv)
                or not argv[0]):
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: argv must be a nonempty string array")
        if not isinstance(check["cwd"], str) or not check["cwd"] or "\0" in check["cwd"]:
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: cwd must be a nonempty path")
        timeout = check.get("timeout_seconds", 60)
        if (type(timeout) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(timeout) or timeout <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: timeout_seconds must be positive and finite")
        artifacts = check.get("artifacts", [])
        if not isinstance(artifacts, list):
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: artifacts must be an array of relative file paths")
        for artifact in artifacts:
            if (not isinstance(artifact, str) or not artifact or "\0" in artifact
                    or Path(artifact).is_absolute() or ".." in Path(artifact).parts
                    or artifact == "."):
                raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: artifact paths must stay within the check's artifact directory")
        if len(artifacts) != len(set(artifacts)):
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: duplicate artifact paths")


def validate_requirements(requirements):
    """Validate a public requirements document without accessing host settings."""
    validate(requirements, {"schema_version": 1, "checks": {}})


def stop(process):
    if os.name == "posix":
        try:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
    else:
        process.kill()
    process.wait()


def execute(requirement, check, config_dir, evidence):
    started = time.monotonic()
    receipt = dict(requirement, started_at=timestamp(), status="missing", argv=None,
                   cwd=None, returncode=None, artifacts=[])
    directory = evidence / requirement["id"]
    directory.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    if check is None:
        receipt["error"] = "No host check configured for this requirement"
    else:
        cwd = Path(check["cwd"]).expanduser()
        cwd = (config_dir / cwd).resolve() if not cwd.is_absolute() else cwd.resolve()
        artifacts = directory / "artifacts"
        artifacts.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        timeout = check.get("timeout_seconds", 60)
        receipt.update(argv=check["argv"], cwd=str(cwd), timeout_seconds=timeout,
                       artifact_directory=str(artifacts))
        environment = dict(os.environ, READINESS_ARTIFACT_DIR=str(artifacts))
        with (directory / "stdout.txt").open("wb") as stdout, (directory / "stderr.txt").open("wb") as stderr:
            try:
                process = subprocess.Popen(check["argv"], cwd=cwd, env=environment,
                                           stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                                           start_new_session=os.name == "posix")
                try:
                    receipt["returncode"] = process.wait(timeout=timeout)
                    receipt["status"] = "passed" if process.returncode == 0 else "failed"
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    stop(process)
                    receipt.update(status="timeout", returncode=process.returncode,
                                   error=f"Check exceeded {timeout} seconds")
                except BaseException:
                    stop(process)
                    raise
            except OSError as error:
                receipt.update(status="error", error=str(error))
        for name in ("stdout.txt", "stderr.txt"):
            path = directory / name
            receipt[name.removesuffix(".txt")] = {
                "path": str(path.relative_to(evidence)), "sha256": digest(path),
                "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
            }
        for name in check.get("artifacts", []):
            path = artifacts / name
            item = {"path": str(path.relative_to(evidence))}
            try:
                if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(artifacts) or not path.is_file():
                    raise ValueError("Artifact missing, not a file, or resolves outside artifact directory")
                item.update(sha256=digest(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size, status="retained")
            except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
                item.update(status="missing", error=str(error))
                if receipt["status"] == "passed":
                    receipt["status"] = "failed"
            receipt["artifacts"].append(item)
    receipt.update(finished_at=timestamp(), elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
    write_json(directory / "receipt.json", receipt)
    return receipt


def run(requirements_path, host_path, evidence):
    requirements_path = requirements_path.expanduser().resolve()
    host_path = host_path.expanduser().resolve()
    evidence = evidence.expanduser().resolve()
    content = requirements_path.read_bytes()
    requirements = json.loads(content)
    host = json.loads(host_path.read_bytes()) if host_path.exists() else {"schema_version": 1, "checks": {}}
    validate(requirements, host)
    evidence.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
    (evidence / "requirements.json").write_bytes(content)
    started = time.monotonic()
    report = {"schema_version": 1, "started_at": timestamp(), "ready": False,
              "complete": False, "requirements_source": str(requirements_path),
              "requirements_sha256": hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(),
              "host_config": str(host_path), "checks": []}
    write_json(evidence / "result.json", report)
    for requirement in requirements["requirements"]:
        report["checks"].append(execute(requirement, host["checks"].get(requirement["id"]),
                                        host_path.parent, evidence))
        write_json(evidence / "result.json", report)
    report.update(ready=all(row["status"] == "passed" for row in report["checks"]),
                  complete=True, finished_at=timestamp(), elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started,
                  unmet_requirements=[row["id"] for row in report["checks"] if row["status"] != "passed"])
    write_json(evidence / "result.json", report)
    return report


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--requirements", type=Path, required=True,
                        help="Explicit capabilities selected from the user's instructions")
    parser.add_argument("--host-config", type=Path, default=Path.home() /
                        ".config/stamped-ai-research-next/readiness.json")
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True, help="New directory for this attempt")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        report = run(args.requirements, args.host_config, args.evidence)
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        parser.exit(2, f"Readiness configuration/evidence error: {error}\n")
    print(json.dumps({"ready": report["ready"], "unmet_requirements": report["unmet_requirements"],
                      "receipt": str(args.evidence.expanduser().resolve() / "result.json")}))
    return 0 if report["ready"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create, prepare and launch a fresh native session using existing host tools.

Never pushes. All generated evidence belongs outside the new worker checkout.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from study_seed import audit_seed, blob, make_seed, research_prompt, worker_manifest
from research_conditions import CONDITION_CHOICES


def run(argv, cwd, capture=False):
    result = subprocess.run([str(x) for x in argv], cwd=cwd, check=True,
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE if capture else None, text=True)
    return result.stdout.strip() if capture else None



def retrieve_inputs(git_command, checkout, inventory, remote):
    """Retrieve selected keys without importing source annex location history."""
    for item in inventory:
        if "annex_key" not in item or (checkout / item["path"]).exists():
            continue
        # get --from silently skips keys with no location record. transferkey
        # contacts the configured mirror directly and retains the original key.
        result = subprocess.run(git_command + ["annex", "transferkey", item["annex_key"],
                                "--from", remote], cwd=checkout,
                                capture_output=True, text=True)
        if result.returncode:
            if not item.get("urls"):
                sys.stderr.write(result.stdout + result.stderr)
                result.check_returncode()
            run(git_command + ["annex", "get", "--", item["path"]], checkout)
        else:
            # transferkey records the local copy, not the remote location.
            # Record the mirror that just supplied these bytes for later clones.
            uuid = run(git_command + ["config", "--get", "remote." + remote + ".annex-uuid"],
                       checkout, True)
            run(git_command + ["annex", "setpresentkey", item["annex_key"], uuid, "1"], checkout)
        if not (checkout / item["path"]).is_file():
            raise SystemExit("Input content was not retrieved: " + item["path"])


def render_judge_prompt(template, study, target_commit, evidence, reference=None):
    """Retain the coordinator's scientific brief independently of the target."""
    content = study.read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
    (evidence / "study.md").write_bytes(content)
    (evidence / "study.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "source": str(study.resolve()), "sha256": digest,
    }, indent=2) + "\n")
    prompt = template.read_text().replace("$TARGET_COMMIT", target_commit)
    prompt += ("\nScientific task supplied by the coordinator (SHA-256 " + digest + ").\n"
               "Use this retained brief, not a worker-edited replacement.\n"
               "Relative source links refer to input/ in the assessed object.\n\n"
               + content.decode())
    if reference:
        material = reference.read_bytes()
        (evidence / "reference.md").write_bytes(material)
        (evidence / "reference.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "source": str(reference.resolve()),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(material).hexdigest(),
        }, indent=2) + "\n")
        prompt += ("\nOptional coordinator evaluation guidance, separate from the scientific task.\n"
                   "Alternative scientifically defensible methods are allowed.\n"
                   "Relative links resolve from " + str(reference.resolve().parent) + ".\n\n"
                   + material.decode())
    destination = evidence / "judge-prompt.md"
    destination.write_text(prompt)
    return destination


def main():
    defaults_parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    defaults_parser.add_argument("--host-config", type=Path, default=Path.home() /
        ".config/stamped-ai-research-next/launch.json")
    preliminary, _ = defaults_parser.parse_known_args()
    defaults = json.loads(preliminary.host_config.read_text()) if preliminary.host_config.is_file() else {}
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--host-config", type=Path, default=preliminary.host_config)
    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])
    parser.add_argument("--branch", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--base", required=True,
                        help="Coordinator revision pinning study/resources/skills; result revision for judges")
    parser.add_argument("--kind", choices=["worktree", "clone"], default="clone")
    parser.add_argument("--clone-path", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--env-manifest", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--approved-hooks", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--trust-sync", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--resolver", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint-repo")
    parser.add_argument("--annex-remote", default="con-hub")
    parser.add_argument("--annex-git-url")
    parser.add_argument("--annex-url")
    parser.add_argument("--study", type=Path,
                        help="Installed study submodule; workers receive only its committed input/ tree")
    parser.add_argument("--reference", type=Path,
                        help="Optional coordinator evaluation guidance file, judges only")
    parser.add_argument("--cli", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=int, default=0,
                        help="Explicit hard limit; 0 waits for completion")
    parser.add_argument("--review-seconds", type=int, default=5400)
    parser.add_argument("--model", default="gpt-6-luna")
    parser.add_argument("--effort", default="high")
    parser.add_argument("--role", choices=["research", "judge"], default="research")
    parser.add_argument("--codex-home", type=Path,
                        help="Prepared isolated public profile, without private global instructions")
    parser.add_argument("--prepare-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--capture-execution", action="store_true",
                        help="Request duct execution records in the worker; use only when authorized")
    parser.add_argument("--condition", choices=CONDITION_CHOICES, default="baseline")
    # Paths/resources are host choices; the coordinator is this checkout, not
    # an old absolute repository path retained in a host configuration.
    parser.set_defaults(**{key: value for key, value in defaults.items() if key != "repo"})
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.seconds < 0 or args.review_seconds < 0:
        parser.error("Time settings must be nonnegative")
    if not args.study or not args.study.is_dir():
        parser.error("--study requires an installed study submodule")
    if args.kind != "clone":
        parser.error("Launch requires --kind clone for an independent Git object store")
    if args.role == "research" and args.reference:
        parser.error("Reference guidance is for judges only")
    if args.role == "judge" and args.condition != "baseline":
        parser.error("Judges use the fixed template; omit --condition")
    for name in ("repo", "env_manifest", "approved_hooks", "trust_sync", "resolver", "cli", "codex_home"):
        value = getattr(args, name)
        if not value:
            parser.error("Missing --" + name.replace("_", "-") + "; configure host defaults once")
        setattr(args, name, Path(value).expanduser().resolve())
    if not args.checkpoint_repo:
        parser.error("Missing --checkpoint-repo; configure host defaults once")
    if not args.annex_git_url or not args.annex_url:
        parser.error("Missing annex remote URLs; configure host defaults once")
    repo = args.repo.resolve()
    base_commit = run(["git", "rev-parse", "--verify", args.base + "^{commit}"], repo, True)
    evidence = args.evidence.resolve()
    evidence.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    if not args.branch.startswith("codex/"):
        parser.error("Use a codex/ branch")
    checkout = (args.clone_path.resolve() if args.clone_path else
                repo.parent / (repo.name + "-workers") / args.branch)
    if checkout.exists():
        parser.error("Worker destination exists; choose a fresh --branch or --clone-path")
    if args.role == "research":
        seed = make_seed(repo, base_commit, args.study, checkout, args.branch,
                         args.condition, args.resolver)
        args.condition = seed["condition"]
        args.prompt = evidence / "research-prompt.md"
        args.prompt.write_bytes(research_prompt(checkout, args.capture_execution))
        (evidence / "input-boundary.json").write_text(json.dumps(seed, indent=2) + "\n")
    else:
        # Fetch only the exact research-object revision. It must itself descend
        # from an input-only seed, not the coordinator repository's history.
        checkout.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        run(["git", "init", "-b", args.branch, checkout], repo)
        run(["git", "fetch", "--no-tags", repo, base_commit], checkout)
        run(["git", "reset", "--hard", "FETCH_HEAD"], checkout)
        # Annex location/URL records belong to the submitted research object.
        # Retain just that metadata branch, without fetching other trial refs.
        annex_ref = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--verify", "git-annex^{commit}"],
                                   cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if annex_ref.returncode == 0:
            annex_commit = annex_ref.stdout.strip()
            run(["git", "fetch", "--no-tags", repo, annex_commit + ":refs/heads/git-annex"], checkout)
            (evidence / "annex-source.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                "repository": str(repo), "commit": annex_commit,
            }, indent=2) + "\n")
        roots = run(["git", "rev-list", "--max-parents=0", "HEAD"], checkout, True).splitlines()
        if len(roots) != 1 or subprocess.run(
                ["git", "cat-file", "-e", roots[0] + ":worker-input.json"],
                cwd=checkout, capture_output=True).returncode:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run explicitly requested resource checks and retain a receipt for every outcome."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import time


def timestamp():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def write_json(path, value):
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def digest(path):
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def validate(requirements, host):
    """Reject ambiguous plans before executing any command."""
    for name, value, keys in (
        ("requirements", requirements, {"schema_version", "requirements"}),
        ("host config", host, {"schema_version", "checks"}),
    ):
        if (not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != keys
                or type(value["schema_version"]) is not int or value["schema_version"] != 1):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must have schema_version 1 and {sorted(keys - {'schema_version'})}")
    rows = requirements["requirements"]
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
        raise ValueError("requirements must be a nonempty list")
    if not isinstance(host["checks"], dict):
        raise ValueError("host checks must be an object keyed by requirement ID")
    seen = set()
    for row in rows:
        if not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != {"id", "description", "source"}:
            raise ValueError("Each requirement needs exactly id, description and source")
        if not all(isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() for value in row.values()):
            raise ValueError("Requirement fields must be nonempty strings")
        identifier = row["id"]
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,79}", identifier) or identifier in seen:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid or duplicate requirement ID: {identifier}")
        seen.add(identifier)
        if identifier not in host["checks"]:
            continue
        check = host["checks"][identifier]
        if (not isinstance(check, dict) or not {"argv", "cwd"} <= set(check)
                or set(check) - {"argv", "cwd", "timeout_seconds", "artifacts"}):
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: check needs argv and cwd; optional timeout_seconds and artifacts")
        argv = check["argv"]
        if (not isinstance(argv, list) or not argv
                or not all(isinstance(arg, str) and "\0" not in arg for arg in argv)
                or not argv[0]):
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: argv must be a nonempty string array")
        if not isinstance(check["cwd"], str) or not check["cwd"] or "\0" in check["cwd"]:
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: cwd must be a nonempty path")
        timeout = check.get("timeout_seconds", 60)
        if (type(timeout) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(timeout) or timeout <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: timeout_seconds must be positive and finite")
        artifacts = check.get("artifacts", [])
        if not isinstance(artifacts, list):
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: artifacts must be an array of relative file paths")
        for artifact in artifacts:
            if (not isinstance(artifact, str) or not artifact or "\0" in artifact
                    or Path(artifact).is_absolute() or ".." in Path(artifact).parts
                    or artifact == "."):
                raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: artifact paths must stay within the check's artifact directory")
        if len(artifacts) != len(set(artifacts)):
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier}: duplicate artifact paths")


def validate_requirements(requirements):
    """Validate a public requirements document without accessing host settings."""
    validate(requirements, {"schema_version": 1, "checks": {}})


def stop(process):
    if os.name == "posix":
        try:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
    else:
        process.kill()
    process.wait()


def execute(requirement, check, config_dir, evidence):
    started = time.monotonic()
    receipt = dict(requirement, started_at=timestamp(), status="missing", argv=None,
                   cwd=None, returncode=None, artifacts=[])
    directory = evidence / requirement["id"]
    directory.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    if check is None:
        receipt["error"] = "No host check configured for this requirement"
    else:
        cwd = Path(check["cwd"]).expanduser()
        cwd = (config_dir / cwd).resolve() if not cwd.is_absolute() else cwd.resolve()
        artifacts = directory / "artifacts"
        artifacts.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        timeout = check.get("timeout_seconds", 60)
        receipt.update(argv=check["argv"], cwd=str(cwd), timeout_seconds=timeout,
                       artifact_directory=str(artifacts))
        environment = dict(os.environ, READINESS_ARTIFACT_DIR=str(artifacts))
        with (directory / "stdout.txt").open("wb") as stdout, (directory / "stderr.txt").open("wb") as stderr:
            try:
                process = subprocess.Popen(check["argv"], cwd=cwd, env=environment,
                                           stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                                           start_new_session=os.name == "posix")
                try:
                    receipt["returncode"] = process.wait(timeout=timeout)
                    receipt["status"] = "passed" if process.returncode == 0 else "failed"
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    stop(process)
                    receipt.update(status="timeout", returncode=process.returncode,
                                   error=f"Check exceeded {timeout} seconds")
                except BaseException:
                    stop(process)
                    raise
            except OSError as error:
                receipt.update(status="error", error=str(error))
        for name in ("stdout.txt", "stderr.txt"):
            path = directory / name
            receipt[name.removesuffix(".txt")] = {
                "path": str(path.relative_to(evidence)), "sha256": digest(path),
                "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
            }
        for name in check.get("artifacts", []):
            path = artifacts / name
            item = {"path": str(path.relative_to(evidence))}
            try:
                if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(artifacts) or not path.is_file():
                    raise ValueError("Artifact missing, not a file, or resolves outside artifact directory")
                item.update(sha256=digest(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size, status="retained")
            except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
                item.update(status="missing", error=str(error))
                if receipt["status"] == "passed":
                    receipt["status"] = "failed"
            receipt["artifacts"].append(item)
    receipt.update(finished_at=timestamp(), elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
    write_json(directory / "receipt.json", receipt)
    return receipt


def run(requirements_path, host_path, evidence):
    requirements_path = requirements_path.expanduser().resolve()
    host_path = host_path.expanduser().resolve()
    evidence = evidence.expanduser().resolve()
    content = requirements_path.read_bytes()
    requirements = json.loads(content)
    host = json.loads(host_path.read_bytes()) if host_path.exists() else {"schema_version": 1, "checks": {}}
    validate(requirements, host)
    evidence.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
    (evidence / "requirements.json").write_bytes(content)
    started = time.monotonic()
    report = {"schema_version": 1, "started_at": timestamp(), "ready": False,
              "complete": False, "requirements_source": str(requirements_path),
              "requirements_sha256": hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(),
              "host_config": str(host_path), "checks": []}
    write_json(evidence / "result.json", report)
    for requirement in requirements["requirements"]:
        report["checks"].append(execute(requirement, host["checks"].get(requirement["id"]),
                                        host_path.parent, evidence))
        write_json(evidence / "result.json", report)
    report.update(ready=all(row["status"] == "passed" for row in report["checks"]),
                  complete=True, finished_at=timestamp(), elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started,
                  unmet_requirements=[row["id"] for row in report["checks"] if row["status"] != "passed"])
    write_json(evidence / "result.json", report)
    return report


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--requirements", type=Path, required=True,
                        help="Explicit capabilities selected from the user's instructions")
    parser.add_argument("--host-config", type=Path, default=Path.home() /
                        ".config/stamped-ai-research-next/readiness.json")
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True, help="New directory for this attempt")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        report = run(args.requirements, args.host_config, args.evidence)
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        parser.exit(2, f"Readiness configuration/evidence error: {error}\n")
    print(json.dumps({"ready": report["ready"], "unmet_requirements": report["unmet_requirements"],
                      "receipt": str(args.evidence.expanduser().resolve() / "result.json")}))
    return 0 if report["ready"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# Coordinator preparation trial: NARPS

Date: 2026-10-15  
Scope: coordinator preparation only; no formal research or assessment was run.

## Result and boundaries

The selected first formal study is `studies/narps`, checked out at `6758fe683b447834d29df954b6be6ea07f6b20f1`. Only that study submodule was initialized. The skills and assessment submodules remain uninitialized; initialize them before freezing and launching round one. The study guidance marks the input package ready and records earlier validation of 54 AO86 participant maps (96,387,264 bytes), with common geometry and matching checksums. Its preparation records also report publication to `con-hub` and independent retrieval. These are prior, pinned study records, not fresh checks of this checkout or the current host.

The worker question is whether potential monetary gain has a positive parametric effect on vmPFC response in the NARPS equal-indifference group, conditional on the fixed AO86 participant maps. Use whole-brain corrected inference and justify the vmPFC definition. The supplied maps are participant effect estimates, not standardized statistics; the upstream analysis is fixed and participant variance maps are absent. Workers may choose defensible group methods and visualizations. Prior team answers and preparation pilot outputs stay outside worker inputs. NARPS is intentionally compact: its guidance reports roughly five-to-six-minute preparation pilots and does not require a minimum compute duration. Do not lengthen the task to meet a duration target.

No experiment results, iteration records, old Git history, other conversations, or personal memory were consulted. No worker or judge was launched, no cluster job was submitted, and nothing was published. The live input verification command and all host capability checks remain unperformed.

Use the pinned NARPS input and scientific question in all rounds; keep prior answers, coordinator guidance, and pilot material out of worker inputs. Keep common resources, tools, network access, model/settings, budgets, prompts, and assessment protocol matched across conditions. Follow the repository defaults unless they are formally resolved before round one:

- Three iterations, three independent workers in each of four conditions per iteration: `baseline`, `discover-general`, `discover-science`, `stamped-explicit` (36 assigned worker runs total).

- Fresh workers with the same committed input package and no coordinator history or previous work. Preserve condition assignment separately from observed discovery, use, and failed attempts.
- The assessor source, runtime, judging prompt/settings, and replay scope fixed before the first worker. Use the exact assessor pin in `assessment-version.json`; validate its source and environment before judging.
- Judge every committed research object independently. Before launching, record a random seed for permuting launch order and randomly preselect one object per condition for a second independent judgment in each round (12 duplicate judgments across three rounds; 48 judgments total).
- Keep scientific adequacy separate from STAMPED item findings; retain `not-checked`, disagreement, individual runs, denominators, effort, operational outcomes, and failures. Do not invent an overall score or claim precise variance from three workers per cell.

Only the pinned reusable skill revision and its internal prompts may be improved between rounds, based on observed results and practices. Keep study questions, worker inputs, condition definitions, common resources, and assessment fixed. Record every skill change and whether the next round addresses its motivating issue. The final round uses the resulting skills without tuning on its results. 1. **Entire capture:** `.codex/hooks.json` is wired to the `entire` hooks, but its wrapper can exit successfully when the CLI is absent. No capture was verified. A read-only account/queue query would show visibility only; a scheduler round trip would demonstrate more but requires an authorized job submission, which this trial forbids. Obtain an approved preflight method or authorization before counting this gate as passed.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

fail() {
  printf 'commit-provenance: %s\n' "$1" >&2
  exit 1
}

thread_id="${CODEX_THREAD_ID:-}"
[ -n "$thread_id" ] || fail 'CODEX_THREAD_ID is unavailable'

codex_root="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"
session_file=$(find "$codex_root/sessions" -type f \
  -name "*-${thread_id}.jsonl" -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)
script_dir=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
provenance_mode='runtime'
if [ -n "$session_file" ]; then
  [ -z "${CODEX_TASK_SERVICE_CONTEXT:-}" ] \
    || fail 'local session transcript is available; remove task-service fallback context'
  turn_context=$(jq -sc '[.[] | select(.type == "turn_context")][-1].payload' \
    "$session_file")
else
  command -v python3 >/dev/null || fail 'python3 is required for runtime-log fallback'
  if turn_context=$(python3 "$script_dir/runtime_context.py" \
    "$codex_root/logs_2.sqlite" "$thread_id" 2>&1); then
    [ -z "${CODEX_TASK_SERVICE_CONTEXT:-}" ] \
      || fail 'fresh runtime metadata is available; remove task-service fallback context'
    printf 'commit-provenance: runtime-log fallback for thread %s, turn %s\n' \
      "$thread_id" "$(jq -r '.turn_id' <<<"$turn_context")" >&2
  elif [ -n "${CODEX_TASK_SERVICE_CONTEXT:-}" ]; then
    turn_context=$(python3 "$script_dir/runtime_context.py" \
      --task-service-context "$CODEX_TASK_SERVICE_CONTEXT" "$thread_id") \
      || fail 'invalid explicit task-service context'
    provenance_mode='task-service-partial'
    printf 'commit-provenance: using task-service verified IDs; model and effort are unavailable\n' >&2
  else
    fail "$turn_context"
  fi
fi
model=$(jq -r '.model // empty' <<<"$turn_context")
effort=$(jq -r '.reasoning_effort // .effort // empty' <<<"$turn_context")
if [ "$provenance_mode" = 'task-service-partial' ]; then
  model='unavailable'
  effort='unavailable'
else
  [ -n "$model" ] || fail 'latest turn context does not contain a model'
  [ -n "$effort" ] || fail 'latest turn context does not contain reasoning effort'
fi

desktop_version=$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy \

  "$app_path/Contents/Info.plist" 2>/dev/null || true)
runtime_path=''
for candidate in \
  "$app_path/Contents/Resources/codex-cli/bin/codex" \

  if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then
    runtime_path=$candidate
    break
  fi
done
[ -n "$runtime_path" ] || fail 'cannot find bundled Codex runtime executable'
runtime_output=$("$runtime_path" --version 2>/dev/null) \
  || fail "cannot execute bundled Codex runtime: $runtime_path"
runtime_version=$(printf '%s\n' "$runtime_output" \
  | awk 'NR == 1 && $1 == "codex-cli" && NF == 2 { print $2 }')
[ -n "$desktop_version" ] || fail 'cannot identify Codex Desktop version'
[ -n "$runtime_version" ] || fail 'cannot identify bundled Codex runtime version'

printf 'Co-Authored-By: Codex Desktop %s (runtime codex-cli %s) / %s <codex@openai.com>\n' \
  "$desktop_version" "$runtime_version" "$model"
printf 'Codex-Reasoning-Effort: %s\n' "$effort"
if [ "$provenance_mode" = 'task-service-partial' ]; then
